title.zh-CN: 01 · 统一时间轴：奖励发生在行动之后
title.en: 01 · A consistent timeline: reward follows action

explanation.zh-CN: 沿着观测、策略、过程响应和反馈读一圈，区分单步奖励与长期目标。结束一次教学轨迹不等于工业系统真正终止。
explanation.en: Follow observation, policy, process response and feedback. Distinguish immediate reward from the long-term objective; ending a teaching rollout is not necessarily physical termination.

keywords: 从一次行动，到长期回报
sourceLabel: 第 01 章 · 从一次行动，到长期回报

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    S["读取观测与当前状态"] --> P["策略选择动作"]
    P --> E["环境演化一个时间步"]
    E --> R["收到奖励与新观测"]
    R --> D{"任务真正结束了吗"}
    D -- "否" --> S
    D -- "是" --> U["记录轨迹并更新策略"]
    U --> S
source.en:
flowchart TD
    S["Read observation and current state"] --> P["Policy selects an action"]
    P --> E["Environment advances one step"]
    E --> R["Receive reward and new observation"]
    R --> D{"Has the task truly ended"}
    D -- "No" --> S
    D -- "Yes" --> U["Record trajectory and update policy"]
    U --> S

title.zh-CN: 04 · 看不全时，就是 POMDP 的语言
title.en: 04 · Incomplete information calls for POMDP language

explanation.zh-CN: 从当时可获得的信息判断状态是否充分；有延迟或隐变量时引入历史与状态估计，再定义动作、奖励和截断语义。
explanation.en: Check whether information available at the time is sufficient. Add history or state estimation for delays and hidden variables, then define actions, rewards and truncation semantics.

keywords: MDP 与 POMDP：先把问题写对
sourceLabel: 第 04 章 · MDP 与 POMDP：先把问题写对

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    Q["定义业务问题与决策周期"] --> O["列出当时真正可获得的信息"]
    O --> M{"当前观测能充分描述过程吗"}
    M -- "近似可以" --> S["构造状态表示"]
    M -- "存在延迟或隐变量" --> H["加入历史与状态估计"]
    H --> S
    S --> A["定义动作边界和奖励成本"]
    A --> T["定义终止与截断语义"]
    T --> C["先用随机策略检查环境"]
source.en:
flowchart TD
    Q["Define the operating problem and decision interval"] --> O["List information actually available then"]
    O --> M{"Does the observation adequately describe the process"}
    M -- "Approximately" --> S["Construct a state representation"]
    M -- "Delays or hidden variables remain" --> H["Add history and state estimation"]
    H --> S
    S --> A["Define action bounds and reward and cost"]
    A --> T["Define termination and truncation"]
    T --> C["Check the environment with a random policy"]

title.zh-CN: 09 · 为什么它不像普通监督学习那么稳定？
title.en: 09 · Why is this less stable than ordinary supervised learning?

explanation.zh-CN: 函数逼近、自举和离策略学习会相互作用。回放与目标网络缓解不同问题，仍需检查价值尺度和独立评估。
explanation.en: Function approximation, bootstrapping and off-policy learning interact. Replay and target networks address different problems; value scales and independent evaluation still need attention.

keywords: 函数逼近：从 Q 表到共享参数
sourceLabel: 第 09 章 · 函数逼近：从 Q 表到共享参数

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    F["函数逼近共享参数"] --> C["一次更新影响多个状态"]
    B["自举目标依赖已有预测"] --> C
    O["离策略数据与目标策略不同"] --> C
    C --> U["可能形成不稳定的误差反馈"]
    U --> R["经验回放改善样本利用"]
    U --> T["目标网络减缓目标变化"]
    R --> V["检查价值尺度与独立评估"]
    T --> V
source.en:
flowchart TD
    F["Function approximation shares parameters"] --> C["One update affects many states"]
    B["Bootstrap targets depend on predictions"] --> C
    O["Data policy differs from target policy"] --> C
    C --> U["Error feedback can become unstable"]
    U --> R["Replay improves sample reuse"]
    U --> T["Target networks slow target changes"]
    R --> V["Check value scales and independent evaluation"]
    T --> V

title.zh-CN: 12 · baseline：评价“比预期更好”，减少噪声
title.en: 12 · A baseline asks whether an outcome was better than expected

explanation.zh-CN: 先采样轨迹，再计算 reward-to-go 与 baseline，最后用优势加权动作 log 概率。注意采样分布与更新目标之间的联系。
explanation.en: Sample a trajectory, compute reward-to-go and a baseline, then weight action log probabilities. Track the link between the sampling distribution and the update objective.

sourceLabel: 第 12 章 · REINFORCE：直接学习行动的概率

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    P["策略分布采样动作"] --> T["收集完整任务轨迹"]
    T --> G["计算每步 reward-to-go"]
    G --> B["减去状态 baseline"]
    B --> L["回报权重乘动作 log 概率"]
    L --> U["更新策略参数"]
    U --> P
    B --> C["下一章用 Critic 学习 baseline"]
source.en:
flowchart TD
    P["Sample actions from the policy"] --> T["Collect complete task trajectories"]
    T --> G["Compute reward-to-go at each step"]
    G --> B["Subtract a state baseline"]
    B --> L["Weight action log probabilities by return"]
    L --> U["Update policy parameters"]
    U --> P
    B --> C["Next chapter: learn the baseline with a Critic"]

title.zh-CN: 13 · 两个损失怎样配合
title.en: 13 · How the two losses work together

explanation.zh-CN: Actor 决定动作分布，Critic 估计价值；它们交换的是学习信号，不是彼此可以无条件替代的目标。
explanation.en: The actor defines the action distribution and the critic estimates value. They exchange learning signals while serving different objectives.

sourceLabel: 第 13 章 · Actor-Critic 与 GAE

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    S["同一批轨迹"] --> V["Critic 估计状态价值"]
    S --> R["奖励与终止信息"]
    V --> D["TD 残差"]
    R --> D
    D --> A["GAE 优势"]
    A --> P["更新 Actor"]
    A --> T["构造价值目标"]
    T --> C["更新 Critic"]
source.en:
flowchart TD
    S["Same trajectory batch"] --> V["Critic estimates state values"]
    S --> R["Rewards and termination flags"]
    V --> D["TD residuals"]
    R --> D
    D --> A["GAE advantages"]
    A --> P["Update actor"]
    A --> T["Construct value targets"]
    T --> C["Update critic"]

title.zh-CN: 15 · 一次完整更新有哪些步骤
title.en: 15 · The stages of a complete update

explanation.zh-CN: 冻结旧策略采样数据，构造优势与概率比，再进行有限轮更新。裁剪约束的是代理目标，不能解释为每个动作的硬执行界。
explanation.en: Freeze the behaviour policy, construct advantages and probability ratios, then perform limited update epochs. Clipping shapes a surrogate objective; it is not a hard execution bound on each action.

keywords: 把 PPO 的裁剪目标拆开
sourceLabel: 第 15 章 · 把 PPO 的裁剪目标拆开

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    P["冻结采样策略"] --> R["采集当前批轨迹"]
    R --> G["计算回报与 GAE"]
    G --> B["打乱并抽取 minibatch"]
    B --> L["裁剪策略损失与价值损失"]
    L --> K{"KL 是否过大"}
    K -- "否" --> B
    K -- "是或轮数完成" --> N["结束本批更新"]
    N --> P
source.en:
flowchart TD
    P["Freeze collection policy"] --> R["Collect the current trajectory batch"]
    R --> G["Compute returns and GAE"]
    G --> B["Shuffle and sample minibatches"]
    B --> L["Clipped policy loss and value loss"]
    L --> K{"Is KL too large"}
    K -- "No" --> B
    K -- "Yes or epochs complete" --> N["Finish this batch update"]
    N --> P

title.zh-CN: 17 · 温度与目标网络各解决什么
title.en: 17 · What temperature and target networks each solve

explanation.zh-CN: 回放、双 Critic、随机 Actor 与熵温度构成 SAC 的更新回路。区分目标网络、停止梯度以及 tanh 后动作密度的坐标。
explanation.en: Replay, twin critics, a stochastic actor and entropy temperature form the SAC update loop. Track target networks, stopped gradients and the coordinate used for tanh-corrected densities.

sourceLabel: 第 17 章 · 最大熵目标与 SAC

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    E["模拟环境交互"] --> D["经验回放"]
    D --> Q["双 Critic 拟合 soft 目标"]
    D --> A["Actor 生成可微动作"]
    Q --> A
    A --> H["熵与温度调整"]
    A --> E
    Q --> T["缓慢更新目标 Critic"]
    T --> Q
source.en:
flowchart TD
    E["Simulated environment interaction"] --> D["Experience replay"]
    D --> Q["Twin critics fit soft targets"]
    D --> A["Actor generates differentiable actions"]
    Q --> A
    A --> H["Entropy and temperature adjustment"]
    A --> E
    Q --> T["Slow target-critic update"]
    T --> Q

title.zh-CN: 18 · 决策树帮助提出问题
title.en: 18 · A decision tree helps you ask questions

explanation.zh-CN: 先判断动作是否影响未来，再判断可用的是历史日志还是模拟交互，最后比较离散/连续动作方法。选型之后仍要统一覆盖、约束与独立评估。
explanation.en: First ask whether actions affect the future, then whether you have historical logs or simulator interaction, and finally compare methods for discrete or continuous actions. Coverage, constraints and independent evaluation remain necessary after selection.

sourceLabel: 第 18 章 · 根据问题选择算法

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    Q["动作是否影响未来状态"] --> S{"有长期影响吗"}
    S -- "否" --> B["监督预测或老虎机基线"]
    S -- "是" --> D{"可获得交互数据吗"}
    D -- "仅历史日志" --> O["BC 与离线 RL"]
    D -- "允许模拟交互" --> A{"动作空间"}
    A -- "有限离散" --> V["表格方法或 DQN"]
    A -- "连续" --> P["PPO、SAC 或 TD3 对比"]
    O --> C["覆盖、约束与独立评估"]
    P --> C
    V --> C
source.en:
flowchart TD
    Q["Does the action affect future states"] --> S{"Long-term effects"}
    S -- "No" --> B["Supervised prediction or bandit baseline"]
    S -- "Yes" --> D{"Can interaction data be obtained"}
    D -- "Historical logs only" --> O["BC and offline RL"]
    D -- "Simulation interaction permitted" --> A{"Action space"}
    A -- "Finite discrete" --> V["Tabular methods or DQN"]
    A -- "Continuous" --> P["Compare PPO, SAC, or TD3"]
    O --> C["Coverage, constraints, and independent evaluation"]
    P --> C
    V --> C

title.zh-CN: 21 · 五层门控：每一层都可单独解释
title.en: 21 · Five-layer gating: explain each layer independently

explanation.zh-CN: 运行决策改变上层设定值，下层控制负责跟踪；门控、延迟反馈与奖励/成本必须沿着实际执行路径记录。
explanation.en: Operational decisions change supervisory setpoints while lower-level control tracks them. Record gates, delayed feedback, rewards and costs along the actual execution path.

keywords: 贯穿案例：烧成系统设定值决策
sourceLabel: 第 21 章 · 贯穿案例：烧成系统设定值决策

title.zh-CN: 22 · 数据构造是一半算法
title.en: 22 · Data construction is half the algorithm

explanation.zh-CN: 离线数据固定后，分布外动作的价值外推成为风险；策略限制、保守估值和独立评估承担不同职责。
explanation.en: With a fixed dataset, extrapolating values for unsupported actions becomes a risk. Policy restrictions, conservative values and independent evaluation play different roles.

keywords: 离线强化学习：从日志到策略
sourceLabel: 第 22 章 · 离线强化学习：从日志到策略

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    D["历史日志"] --> T["按时间与可见性构造转移"]
    T --> S["训练、验证、测试隔离"]
    S --> B["行为克隆基线"]
    S --> R["保守离线策略"]
    B --> E["支持域与独立评估"]
    R --> E
    E --> F["记录收益、成本与不确定性"]
source.en:
flowchart TD
    D["Historical logs"] --> T["Construct transitions by time and visibility"]
    T --> S["Separate training, validation, and testing"]
    S --> B["Behavioral cloning baseline"]
    S --> R["Conservative offline policy"]
    B --> E["Support and independent evaluation"]
    R --> E
    E --> F["Record payoff, costs, and uncertainty"]

title.zh-CN: 23 · MBPO 的启发：从真实状态短程分叉
title.en: 23 · The MBPO lesson: short branches from real states

explanation.zh-CN: 区分真实经验与模型生成的短轨迹，检查模型误差如何进入策略更新。增加模拟数据不自动增加现实证据。
explanation.en: Separate real experience from short model-generated trajectories and inspect how model errors enter policy updates. More simulated data is not automatically more physical evidence.

keywords: 模型学习、Dyna 与短程推演
sourceLabel: 第 23 章 · 模型学习、Dyna 与短程推演

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    D["真实历史状态库"] --> S["抽取有覆盖的起始状态"]
    S --> M["模型与当前策略短程推演"]
    M --> U{"不确定性与边界检查"}
    U -- "可信" --> B["加入模型经验缓冲区"]
    U -- "不可信" --> X["停止分支并记录原因"]
    B --> P["混合经验改善策略"]
    P --> M
source.en:
flowchart TD
    D["Real historical state bank"] --> S["Sample covered initial states"]
    S --> M["Short model and policy rollouts"]
    M --> U{"Uncertainty and boundary checks"}
    U -- "Credible" --> B["Add to model replay buffer"]
    U -- "Not credible" --> X["Stop branch and record reason"]
    B --> P["Improve policy with mixed experience"]
    P --> M

title.zh-CN: 1. 先问“决定什么”，再问“用什么算法”
title.en: 1. Identify the decision before choosing an algorithm

explanation.zh-CN: 先定位决策层，再理解 RTO、跟踪 MPC、经济 MPC 和学习策略各自回答的问题。
explanation.en: Locate the decision layer before comparing RTO, tracking MPC, economic MPC and learned policies.

keywords: 从全厂控制到运行指标决策
From plantwide control to operational decisions
sourceLabel: 从全厂控制到运行指标决策

flowchart TD
    P["生产计划与产品要求"] --> O["经济目标与操作边界"]
    O --> S["上层设定值决策"]
    M["状态估计与质量信息"] --> S
    S --> G["门控与执行授权"]

flowchart TD

    G --> C["DCS and PID or APC"]
    C --> K["Physical kiln process"]
    K --> M
    K --> A["Indicator accounting and audit"]
    A --> O

title.zh-CN: 5. 不把相关性直接写成动作效果
title.en: 5. Association is not automatically an action effect

explanation.zh-CN: 把煤耗、电耗、质量、产量、排放与平稳性放回单位、边界和时间，再讨论策略收益。
explanation.en: Put fuel, electricity, quality, throughput, emissions and stability back into units, boundaries and time before comparing policies.

keywords: 运行指标、权衡与因果混杂
sourceLabel: 运行指标、权衡与因果混杂

    H --> Q

    X --> Q
source.en:
flowchart TD
    D["Feed and load changes"] --> A["Operator setpoint proposal"]
    D --> Q["Later quality and energy"]
    H["History and hidden judgment"] --> A
    H --> Q
    A --> X["Process after inner control"]
    X --> Q

title.zh-CN: 4. 两种 epsilon 不应混淆
title.en: 4. Two meanings of epsilon

explanation.zh-CN: 用完整算例解释尺度、偏好、可行性、机会约束与软约束为什么不能混为一谈。
explanation.en: Worked examples separate scaling, preferences, feasibility, chance constraints and soft constraints.

keywords: 从指标到目标、Pareto 与约束
From indicators to objectives, Pareto order and constraints
sourceLabel: 从指标到目标、Pareto 与约束

source.zh-CN:
flowchart TD
    A["候选点或轨迹"] --> F["量纲与时间核算"]
    F --> C["可行性检查"]
    C -->|"不可行"| R["拒绝或继续搜索"]
    C -->|"可行"| P["Pareto 比较"]
    P --> W["偏好或预算选择"]
    W --> G["独立执行审核"]
    R --> A
source.en:
flowchart TD
    A["Candidate point or trajectory"] --> F["Units and time accounting"]

title.zh-CN: 1. 先问一个个体表示什么，再问使用哪种进化算法
title.en: 1. Ask what an individual represents before choosing the algorithm

explanation.zh-CN: 拆开候选表示、评价模型、约束比较与搜索器，推导 NSGA-II 和 MOEA/D，解释动态优化如何与 MPC、RL 连接。
explanation.en: Separate representation, evaluation, feasibility and search. Derive NSGA-II and MOEA/D, then connect dynamic optimization with MPC and RL.

keywords: 进化优化：从 Pareto 搜索到滚动轨迹
Evolutionary optimization: Pareto search and rolling trajectories
sourceLabel: 进化优化：从 Pareto 搜索到滚动轨迹

title.zh-CN: 1. 改变的是求解对象，而不只是算法名字
title.en: 1. The object being solved changes, not just the algorithm name

explanation.zh-CN: 从当前候选、未来轨迹推到反馈策略，说明历史、化验可用性、占用分布、延迟回报与独立约束如何进入同一个问题。
explanation.en: Move from a present candidate to a trajectory and a feedback policy, connecting history, assay availability, occupancy, delayed returns and separate constraints.

keywords: 从指标优化到序列决策：MDP、POMDP 与 CMDP

sourceLabel: 从指标优化到序列决策：MDP、POMDP 与 CMDP

title.zh-CN: 1. 一张网络结构图必须同时是一张信息权限图
title.en: 1. An architecture diagram is also an information-permission diagram

explanation.zh-CN: 逐一说明历史编码、软测量、tanh Actor、双 Critic、温度、成本、离线支持与世界模型各自学习什么，以及门控改变了哪些语义。
explanation.en: Explain what the history encoder, soft sensor, tanh actor, twin critics, temperature, costs, offline support and world model each learn—and what gating changes.

title.zh-CN: 1. “用了工业数据”不能回答“谁在现场决定动作”
title.en: 1. Industrial data do not establish who chose actions in the plant

explanation.zh-CN: 按实际可读的一手材料建立证据矩阵，区分生产数据、模型闭环、现场试验和运营报告，核验相关论文归属与适用范围。
explanation.en: An evidence matrix based on accessible primary material, separating plant data, model loops, field trials and operational accounts while checking attribution and scope.

keywords: 证据地图：论文、仿真、现场与尚未回答的问题
Evidence map: theory, simulation, field operation and open claims
sourceLabel: 证据地图：论文、仿真、现场与尚未回答的问题

flowchart TD

  A --> T["理论与仿真证据"]
  A --> D["生产日志或代理模型证据"]
  A --> F["现场执行证据"]
  T --> L["记录假设、对照与适用边界"]
  D --> L

source.en:
flowchart TD
  C["Specific claim to verify"] --> A["Original or official primary material"]
  A --> T["Theory and simulation evidence"]
  A --> D["Plant logs or surrogate evidence"]
  A --> F["Physical execution evidence"]

  D --> L
  F --> L
  L --> R["Supported wording and open questions"]

title.zh-CN: 3. 单步预测好，并不意味着闭环推演可靠
title.en: 3. Accurate one-step prediction need not produce reliable closed-loop rollouts

explanation.zh-CN: 围绕隐藏状态、离线支持、闭环模型误差、罕见风险、目标漂移和评价统计提出可检验的下一步，而不是把复杂网络当作答案。
explanation.en: Testable next steps for hidden state, offline support, closed-loop model error, rare risk, changing objectives and statistical evaluation.

keywords: 开放问题：从预测准确到决策可信还缺什么
Open problems: from accurate prediction to credible decisions
sourceLabel: 开放问题：从预测准确到决策可信还缺什么

title.zh-CN: 1. 研究主线应从决策问题贯穿到证据
title.en: 1. Connect the research question to the evidence

explanation.zh-CN: 沿“状态感知→质量预测→动态多目标优化→设定值决策”主线，定义数据契约、基线、消融、失败标准和分阶段产物。
explanation.en: Turn the state–quality–optimization–setpoint chain into explicit data contracts, baselines, ablations, failure criteria and staged deliverables.

keywords: 研究路线：把已有模块变成六个可证伪问题
